label: Markets
heading: Three metros we know street by street.
lede: We only invest where our crews, managers and relationships already work every day.

cities.name: Columbus
cities.body: Ohio’s capital and largest city, with state government, The Ohio State University and a growing technology and advanced-manufacturing base. Our headquarters and largest operating team.

cities.name: Dayton
cities.body: Anchored by Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, major health systems and the University of Dayton, with lower entry prices than larger Midwest metros.

cities.name: Cincinnati
cities.body: Home to Fortune 500 headquarters, the University of Cincinnati and a large healthcare cluster, with deep, diverse rental demand.
